summary: HDFC Bank furnished a 6-K disclosing its board's September 12, 2026 approval, on Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee recommendation and under the Banking Regulation Act 1949 and RBI Commercial Banks Governance Directions 2025, to submit two CEO/MD candidates in preference order with proposed remuneration for a three-year term, pending RBI approval. The board also approved re-appointing V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director from November 23, 2026 to November 22, 2027, appointed Jimmy Tata as Executive Director for three years from RBI approval, and added a fourth whole-time director position for succession pipeline. Shareholder approval will follow; watch RBI timing and CEO identity.
